desc: Ideate candidate approaches and select the trie Euler-interval maxima approach.

Implement and verify the trie Euler-interval maxima solution end-to-end in the starter code: build the trie with terminal indices and subtree counts; if k >= n return zeros; iterative DFS assigns each word index a position, records each node's first/last interval and the deepest ancestor with count >= k+1 for each terminal; for every node with count >= k update end/start depth arrays by its interval; compute prefix/suffix maxima to get the best good interval not containing each position; answer[i] = max(on[i], off[i]); run the provided examples and edge cases (k = 1, duplicates, words that are prefixes of others, n == k) and fix any failures.
